narrative.northStar: A ride journal beside an atlas
narrative.overview: Photographs from the ride introduce the terrain. The atlas follows the same journey through numbered stops, and the journal gives the story room to unfold in serif prose. Cool ink frames navigation and geography, lilac paper carries the text, and coral draws the eye to the route and its controls.
keyCharacteristics: Photographs with location and date captions.
Condensed headings, serif prose and sans-serif controls.
Chapter numbers shared by the map, chapter navigation and article.

rules.name: The Route Color Rule
rules.body: Use coral for the route and its corresponding chapter states. Use the darker coral for chapter numerals on paper.

dos: Do keep route styles distinct in the geometry and the legend.
Do preserve visible focus on chapter links and map pins.
Do keep photograph captions and dates directly below their images.
